review.tagline: Collection of 161+ Claude Code subagent definitions in 10 categories
review.summary: Markdown subagent definitions for Claude Code, grouped into 10 categories such as core development, language specialists, infrastructure, quality and security, and data and AI. Install them as Claude Code plugins (for example voltagent-lang), by copying files into ~/.claude/agents/ or .claude/agents/, or with a shell installer script.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want ready-made specialist subagents
strengths: Installable per category via claude plugin marketplace, so you add only the groups you need
Covers many languages and frameworks, including Django, Rails, Spring Boot, Flutter and Terraform
Interactive and standalone shell installers; standalone one needs only curl
MIT licensed; agents are plain Markdown files you can copy and edit
weaknesses: Prompt definitions only; README shows no tests or evals of agent quality
Written for Claude Code; other agent tools would need the files adapted
Meta-orchestration agents are meant to be used with other categories installed too
No tagged releases; README carries sponsor placements
